## Astronomical 0.2.97
### A chat app with a menu-bar companion - Astronomical is now a regular Mac app with a Dock icon and a menu bar that is always reachable, plus a small menu-bar companion that runs the engine. - Command-Q quits the chat app and leaves the engine serving. Choose **Quit and Stop Engine** in the app menu, or **Quit** in the menu-bar item, to stop everything. - Update controls and **Launch at Login** moved from the menu-bar popover to the app menu. An existing Launch at Login setting carries over. - Thin Talk opens on first launch and Astro waits for its engine. Any welcome answer can be changed on its own from Your Astro.
### Models page - Observatory's model page is rebuilt as **Models**: what is on this Mac first, then one row per model with a 4-bit / 6-bit / 8-bit version picker, a speed meter and a one-line summary. - Light and dark themes that follow the Mac, with an Auto / Light / Dark switch. - A model this version cannot run now offers only Cancel. The text-only Ornith 35B 8-bit is retired from the catalog.
### Engine - Dense models keep the layers that fit in memory and stream the rest from the SSD, so Ornith 9B runs on 8 GB Macs. The menu and Observatory show the streamed layers. - New Expert Atlas streaming format with a converter, and faster reads of cached expert pages. - The vision tower's weights are released after each image request. - Four input-validation defects fixed in model parsers.
### Compatibility - macOS 14.0 or later on Apple silicon. - Installed models, chats and settings are preserved. The configuration format is unchanged.
The disk image is signed with a Developer ID, notarized by Apple and stapled.
